title: Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A fully-configurable, TPC-DS-like relational synthetic dataset generator with schema metadata and ETL lineage documentation, currently built on hand-coded and YAML-driven generators rather than statistical modeling. SDV is listed in requirements.txt and named only as a future-work item to plug in its multi-table synthesizers for correlated customer-order-transaction data, with no current usage in the code.
evidence: README Future Directions: 'Realistic Joint Distributions (SDV Integration) - Plug in SDV's multi-table synthesizers...'; requirements.txt: sdv>=0.15.0
